title: Studio Data pillar: the Records grid draws fewer rows than its footer counts, with a stretched gap before the last drawn row (HotCRM crm_account, 10 records, 1280 x 900)
body:
Filing gate: ① — a product defect with a reproduction, user-visible (rows an author expects to see are not drawn).

## Symptom

In Studio, Data pillar, Records tab, the grid draws fewer rows than the footer counts. A tall empty band then sits before the last row it does draw.

## Reproduction (two independent readings)

1. **On `main` at `cf430cd`**: the skeleton PR's committed screenshot `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/skeleton-data-records-light.png` (1280 × 900, HotCRM `crm_account`).
   - The footer reads "10 records".
   - The grid draws rows 1–8, then an empty band about 230 px tall, then row 9 at the bottom of the column. Row 10 is not drawn.
2. **In a local console** (objectui `claude/issue-12450-data-pillar-layout`, HotCRM served by `objectstack dev --fresh`, 1280 × 900): the `os-dev` run for objectui#12450 saw the grid draw 6 of the 9 rows its footer counted, with the last drawn row stretched to the bottom of the column.
   - The same run with an 8-row object did not reproduce it.
   - Recorded in PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12477's Acceptance notes.

Not root-caused, and no code location is named yet. Candidates are the Studio host (`renderStudioGridList` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`), `packages/plugin-list` ListView and `packages/plugin-grid` ObjectGrid. Whether console list pages show the same thing is not measured.

reach: the Studio Data pillar Records tab (a UI door), measured wrong twice as above.

## Who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The fix reader is the lane that owns the Studio Records grid (`domain:ui`). This is not part of the epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446: objectui#12450's acceptance does not depend on it.

## Dedupe (2026-10-15, MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed)

- "Studio records grid rows missing last row stretched gap blank space": 7 hits, none this defect (closest is objectui#4567, a duplicate find(), closed).
- "grid virtualization row height wrong rows not rendered empty gap ObjectGrid": 10 hits read of 26, none this defect. Relevant grid cards came back (objectui#12393, objectui#11574), so the channel was live.
